description: Autonomous Co-STORM-style research: warm-start stable expert perspectives, launch one independent subagent per expert in parallel for each round, join grounded results under a Moderator, maintain a reorganized knowledge map, and synthesize a cited report without user intervention; hard blocks terminate with a partial handoff.

dependencies.purpose: Own autonomous perspective-guided research, grounded expert turns, and knowledge-space maintenance.
Provide source discovery and web-search evidence support required by research-nex.
Own evidence-grounded report synthesis, report quality review, and citation repair.
